rationale.text: The head holds two title elements: the first is empty, the second has text. Browsers use the first, so document.title is empty. The wording asks whether the page has a title given by the title tag and does not say which of two elements gives it, nor whether an empty one counts. The custom check answers cannot_tell (step 4: the first title element is empty); only the record supports this branch. axe's document-title faults on the empty document.title through an evidence-only link, so at full the reason is alternative_unresolved; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled. With the valid case, this is the mixed pair for this entry: one title element valid beside one with no content is never passed.
